verdict.rationale: The firm's early-stage Formation page says it helps founders make "optimal, tax-efficient choices around how to structure their business entities and ownership." That shows it advises on entity choice, but it is a service description rather than published guidance. Its Knowledge Hub sits inside the client-exclusive Catalyze platform, so it is not public, and its listed offices do not include the UK, Germany or India. Missing for 10: publicly published entity-choice guidance; a jurisdiction-of-incorporation comparison; coverage of Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd; market-specific recommendations; independent corroboration.
